title: AgentTrail golden dataset record
description: One record of the synthetic golden dataset (data/golden_cases.jsonl). Synthetic evaluation data only — this does not represent real UK benefit policy. Every string is constrained by an approved enum, ID pattern, or version pattern; applicant inputs are enumerated only and cannot contain PII.

case_id.description: Synthetic case identifier. Never a real reference number.

dataset_version.description: Semantic version of the ground-truth dataset this record belongs to.

input.description: Applicant snapshot. Exactly these three enumerated fields; no free-text or PII fields are permitted.

age_band.description: Recorded but routing-inert in v1.0.0: age never affects routing, confidence, or reason.

income_band.description: Routing-inert in v1.0.0: differentiates decide reason codes only.

evidence_status.description: Sole driver of routing and confidence in v1.0.0.

expected.description: Ground-truth label derived deterministically from input by the synthetic labelling policy v1.0.0.
